ambiguities.explanation: The temporal phrase 'within 2 s' can modify the action of 'inform' (the notification must happen within 2 seconds) or it can modify the action of 'detecting damage' (the detection itself must occur within 2 seconds). This creates ambiguity regarding the scope of the time constraint.
possible_interpretations: The system must inform the security service within 2 seconds after the damage has been detected (Time constraint on informing).
The system must detect the damage within 2 seconds, and then inform the security service (Time constraint on detection).
